description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across different language families. The horizontal axis displays language family categories, labeled “Basque” through “IE-Slavic”, listed in an unspecified order. The vertical axis, labeled “# tasks”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each language family is represented by a single colored bar. The “IE-Slavic” bar is light blue and extends to approximately 72 tasks, while the “Basque” bar is dark blue and extends to approximately 2 tasks. The “IE-Romance” bar is blue and extends to approximately 42 tasks, the “IE-Germanic” bar is yellow-green and extends to approximately 48 tasks, the “Uralic” bar is light green and extends to approximately 25 tasks, the “IE-Baltic” bar is light orange and extends to approximately 16 tasks, the “IE-other” bar is red and extends to approximately 12 tasks, the “IE-Indic” bar is orange and extends to approximately 10 tasks, the “Semitic” bar is dark orange and extends to approximately 11 tasks, and the “Turkic” bar is orange and extends to approximately 8 tasks. No bars are visually emphasized, and no additional annotations are present.
